name: Mutable state (var) should be avoided
description: Mutable state should be avoided.

name: Null should be avoided
description: Null should be avoided, consider using Option instead.

name: Throwing exceptions should be avoided
description: Exceptions should be avoided, consider encoding the error in the return type instead.

name: Return should be avoided
description: Return should be avoided, consider using if/else instead.

name: While loops should be avoided
description: While loops should be avoided, consider using recursion instead.

name: Semicolons are disabled
description: Semicolons are disabled.

name: Tabs are disabled
description: Tabs are disabled.

name: XML literals should be avoided
description: XML literals should be avoided.

name: asInstanceOf casts should be avoided
description: asInstanceOf casts are disabled, use pattern matching instead.

name: asInstanceOf[Matchable] casts should use the asMatchable extension method
description: Prefer the .asMatchable extension method over an asInstanceOf[Matchable] cast for readability.

name: isInstanceOf checks should be avoided
description: isInstanceOf checks are disabled, use pattern matching instead.

name: Final vals should be avoided
description: Final vals cause problems with incremental compilation.

name: Pattern matching in val assignment should be avoided
description: Pattern matching in a val assignment using a non-tuple pattern risks a MatchError at runtime.

name: Covariant type parameters should be avoided
description: Covariant types could lead to error-prone situations.

name: Contravariant type parameters should be avoided
description: Contravariant types could lead to error-prone situations.

name: Val fields in traits or abstract classes should be avoided
description: Val fields in traits or abstract classes can trigger initialization order bugs.

name: Implicit objects should be avoided
description: Implicit objects may cause implicit resolution errors.

name: Implicit conversions should be avoided
description: Implicit conversions reduce type safety compared to explicit conversions.

name: Default arguments should be avoided
description: Default args makes it hard to use methods as functions.

name: Universal equality (==) should be avoided
description: == and != are unsafe since they allow comparing two unrelated types.

name: Universal equality (!=) should be avoided
description: == and != are unsafe since they allow comparing two unrelated types.

name: Overriding finalize should be avoided
description: finalize should not be used, its semantics are unreliable.
